title.narrative: Scale up of HIV prevention to contribute to the reduction of HIV related morbidity and mortality by 2017 - Cameroon (01-Apr-2016-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Cameroon, HIV, Cameroon National Association for Family Welfare (CAMNAFAW)This program has the following goals: Contribute to reducing HIV and TB-related morbidity and mortality by 2017. Contribute to reducing new HIV-related infections by 50 percent by 2017. The objectives of this program are: Achieve 100 percent completeness and promptness of expected reports from TB and HIV programs and carry out at least 90 percent of planned supervisions in 2017. Ensure that at least 80 percent of the key populations adopt less risky behavior by 2017. Improve program and grant management capacity so as to increase the budget implementation rate to more than 90 percent in 2017. Increase the 12-month survival rate among PLHIV to at least 95 percent by 2017. Reduce the mother-to-child HIV transmission rate to less than 5 percent
